newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products hold, wait for crude to settle.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products hold, wait for crude to settle.

text.p: Med oil products were steady to easier on Tuesday as the market kept a wary eye on unsettled crude.

Gas oil drifted 50 cents lower on futures and premiums were stable in thin volume. The market remained long with plenty of Russian availability as well as two cargoes of Bulgarian 0.2 heating oil winter specification (-5/-15).

A cargo of Russian traded at cif high quotes +$1.50 basis Genoa for arrival by end-1996 but in other discussion premiums for 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil was around high cif quotes +$1 basis Genoa.
Interest also focused on arbitrage opportunities to the east. One trader said ideas were around $248/250 a tonne fixed price basis south China.
Gasoline prices were holding Monday's futures driven gains with some fundamental back-up coming from buying into the East Med but European buying was generally thin.
Eurograde cargoes were talked around $220/$223 a tonne cif Med with freight worth around $10 a tonne.
Naphtha was also steady but thin end user demand continued to dampen the effects of Monday's crude and product futures price hike.
Cif deliveries talked in a range around $218/$221 a tonne cif Med.
Fuel oil activity was slow with most players seen to have covered their immediate requirements.
"People are preparing for the holidays," said one trader on the lack of business.
"Crude still looks unsettled, so it's better to sit it out," added another.
High sulphur cracked fuel was pegged in the mid teens cif Med while low sulphur material was put around $136-138 cif Med.
